part.text:
I couldn't like the post. This environment has no way to send taps to the simulator. `simctl` can take screenshots and launch or open apps, but it has no tap or touch command, and host GUI automation is unavailable. I didn't try building an XCUITest runner, since that would mean creating an Xcode test project from scratch.

The app is on the Following feed. The first post is by @whiskers.test ("Mochi napping in a sunbeam"). Its heart icon is at about (512, 1410) in the screenshot, which is 923×2000 pixels. If you can tap there on the simulator, or give me a tool that can send taps, I'll finish the task.
